title: Common Interfaces for Breeding-Scheme Simulation
text: qgsim provides small R-facing specification, validation, backend dispatch, standardized result layer breeding-scheme simulation tools. Version 0.0.1 includes one pure-R reference backend. exists establish test backend contract; intended scientifically complete breeding simulator. execution flow deliberately explicit: Future backend packages can translate validated plan C++, Fortran, Python, Julia implementations returning result schema.
code: library(qgsim)  scheme <- breeding_scheme(   generations = 3,   population_size = 100,   selected_parents = 20,   offspring_per_mating = 5 )  plan <- qgsim_compile(   scheme = scheme,   seed = 123,   outputs = output_spec(     populations = TRUE,     metrics = "mean_breeding_value"   ) )  result <- qgsim_run(plan, backend = "r_reference")  qgsim_metrics(result) qgsim_populations(result) breeding_scheme() -> qgsim_compile() -> qgsim_validate()                   -> qgsim_run() -> qgsim_result
